Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned with your timeline; below is a proposed plan and a couple of asks.

Plan (high level):
1) I'll attach a CAIQ draft (CAIQ-draft-v1.xlsx) — answers are Redwood-verified but marked where we expect final legal redlines.
2) Jonas will create a short upload window for Heliox on our Vendr profile (preferred) and also generate a presigned S3 link if you need direct upload.
3) Mina from Security will attach a one-pager on KMS rotation and presign TTL.

Quick answers:
- Presigned S3 links TTL: default 6 hours; we can issue up to 48 hours for an exception with a brief justification and documented audit trail.
- KMS rotation: key material rotates quarterly; we keep a signed rotation manifest in our evidence bucket (we'll provide the signed manifest PDF).

Attachments: CAIQ-draft-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 250KB), presign-instructions.txt (txt, 1.2KB)

Action items for Heliox: confirm whether you prefer a Vendr/Whistic invite or a direct presigned S3 upload. If presign, tell us preferred TTL (6/24/48h).

Jonas/mina — can you pick this up? Jonas, please set up the Vendr invite and a presign token option; Mina, can you draft the KMS rotation one-pager and attach the signed manifest.

Thanks,

Alex — looping back with what I configured: 

• Vendr profile: Invite sent to alex.turner@heliox.com and procurement@heliox.com (link: https://whistic.com/invite/heliox-req-77). The profile is in staging with the CAIQ file uploaded under "Supporting Evidence > CAIQ".
• Presigned S3 option: I generated a presign workflow; to keep things auditable we issue a presign token via our internal portal and log the request in the evidence-receipts bucket.
• Upload window: I've scheduled a 36-hour presign window starting 2026-12-02T12:00:00Z — this will issue tokens with the TTL you request but will require a one-time request form so we can attach the signed manifest.

Attachments included here: presign-instructions.txt (contains step-by-step S3 upload + required filename format), and I uploaded CAIQ-draft-v1.xlsx to the Vendr staging area.

Internal notes for Mina: when you send the KMS rotation one-pager, add the signed manifest (manifest-2026Q4-signed.pdf) to the Vendr "Cryptographic Controls" section. If procurement wants additional validation (e.g. HSM provider attestation), flag it and we'll escalate.

If Heliox prefers direct SFTP instead of presigned S3, let me know — we can open a temporary SFTP account scoped to a temp prefix (requires an access request).

Onboarding link and inventory: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Heliox-CAIQ
